text:
This run cannot answer which hiring plan meets both delivery and the £400k salary limit.

- The salary constraint was left unchecked: annual salary spend is modelled as a calculated quantity on an incompatible frame, and every option lacked a stated salary effect, so the run treated those effects as unchanged.
- No option can be put forward: the comparison is fragile, near-tied, and rests entirely on Olumi-authored estimates rather than user-validated inputs.
- The model is particularly sensitive to assumed incremental delivery capacity; its source is Olumi’s estimate.
